findings.description: System MUST read evicted data from SSD directly into GPU staging buffers, bypassing host DRAM.
findings.notes: pipelined_ssd_to_gpu_p2p reads NVMe directly into P2P ring GPU BAR1 slots via ReadAsync commands

findings.description: System MUST copy data from staging buffers to the client's GPU destination.
findings.notes: D2D cudaMemcpyAsync from ring slot dev_ptr to gpu_dst with CUDA_MEMCPY_DEVICE_TO_DEVICE

findings.description: System MUST pre-allocate a fixed ring of 64 GPU staging buffers at initialization via cudaMalloc + GDRCopy BAR1 mapping + spdk_mem_register.
findings.notes: P2P_RING_SLOTS=64, cudaMalloc + create_spdk_dma_buffer_from_gpu_bar per slot, 4 CUDA streams allocated.

findings.description: System MUST partition the staging ring for concurrent thread access using ThreadPartition.
findings.notes: ThreadPartition::new divides ring evenly, caps at MAX_QD_PER_THREAD=16.

findings.description: System MUST pipeline SSD reads with D2D GPU copies using FIFO completion ordering, 4 CUDA streams round-robin.
findings.notes: FIFO ordering, round-robin stream selection (completed % num_streams), sync at sync_interval boundaries, final sync.

findings.description: System MUST panic on first cold lookup if the P2P ring was not initialized.
findings.notes: p2p_ref.expect() panics on first cold lookup when ring is absent.

findings.description: The P2P ring is allocated once at initialization and is immutable for the component's lifetime. There is no runtime path selection.
findings.notes: Minor drift: promote_and_serve has a runtime `if let Some(ref p2p)` check with a DRAM fallback path. The fallback only activates if P2P ring is None (test/staging only; FR-006 ensures production always has P2P).

findings.description: System MUST implement the same interface as the standard dispatcher, serving as a drop-in replacement.
findings.notes: define_component! provides [IDispatcher]. All trait methods implemented.

findings.description: System MUST promote successfully read cold entries back to DRAM after completing the read.
findings.notes: Moderate drift: Implementation now uses lazy async backfill. After P2P cold read, key stays as BlockDevice. A background DramBackfillWorker re-reads from SSD into DRAM with configurable delay (backfill_delay_ms, default 10ms, 0=disabled). Promotion is deferred, not immediate. Rationale: immediate backfill caused 30% cold throughput regression from NVMe contention.

findings.description: System MUST release all staging resources on shutdown with no leaks.
findings.notes: shutdown() destroys P2P ring, pipeline ring, warm stream, stops backfill worker.

findings.description: System MUST handle read failures gracefully without corrupting ring state.
findings.notes: P2P pipeline returns Err on read failure; ring slots not resubmitted; other in-flight lookups proceed independently.

findings.description: Performance measurement is handled by external benchmarking tools.
findings.notes: Component implements IDispatcher which certus-api-bench_v2.py exercises. No in-component hooks needed.

findings.description: System MUST implement promote_to_memory_tier(keys) using pipelined_ssd_to_dram_only.
findings.notes: Groups keys by drive, one thread per drive, calls pipelined_ssd_to_dram_only. No P2P ring involvement.

unspecced_code_details.feature: DramBackfillWorker (lazy DRAM promotion after P2P cold reads)
unspecced_code_details.description: Per-drive background threads that re-read SSD data into DRAM memory-tier slots after P2P cold reads serve the client. Throttled by configurable backfill_delay_ms.
Configurable delay between background DRAM backfill jobs. Default 10ms. Set to 0 to disable backfill entirely.
Per-drive background writer threads that persist memory-tier entries to SSD asynchronously after populate().
Periodic thread monitoring SSD utilization and evicting cold entries when threshold exceeded.
Two-phase write API bypassing the populate->background-write path for bulk ingest.
Additional pipeline functions for DRAM fallback path and batch operations.

recommendations: Update FR-009 to reflect lazy async backfill design with configurable delay
Add FR-014 for backfill_delay_ms config semantics (0=disabled, >0=throttled)
Clarify FR-007 to acknowledge DRAM fallback exists for test/staging environments
